title: Full-production spectral discretization to continuum PDE
statement: For the hash-pinned full-production functional and fixed-torus PDE, P3 stages 1-3 verify spatial self-convergence, the real energy-gradient identity, fourth-order manufactured finite-time convergence, unforced trajectory and energy convergence, and Hessian/Ritz grid convergence with an isolated-cluster residual/gap certificate. Stage 5 independently implements the functional and, after exact Fourier prolongation, verifies convergence of the canonical collocation residual to an oversampled M=24,32 projected quadrature-gradient proxy. Stage 6 derives a uniform positive-time solution-ball mismatch bound C(R,tau,T)N^-2 from P2 smoothing and the fourth-order residual order. Stage 7 computes the prerequisite all-time H2 envelope M2(R) for declared initial balls directly from a Fourier embedding, P1 energy upper bound, and P2 coercivity. The independent portable implementation closes the CPU and recorded CUDA complex128/64 consistency matrix; the integrated verifier validates the hash-bound evidence matrix.
scope: T4 STRONG-EVIDENCE. Fixed T3, pinned full-production parameters and positive regularisers, eta_shell=0. The qualitative solution-ball statement applies to every H2 initial ball only on fixed positive-time intervals 0<tau<=t<=T and has an unevaluated constant C(R,tau,T). Spatial and finite-time grids are frozen in stages 1-2; Hessian/Ritz N=8,12,16 against N=20; independent Galerkin proxy N=8,12,16 against M=24,32; CPU and CUDA complex128/64 precision matrix at N=8 on the recorded torch 2.13.0+cu130 / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU environment. T4 records strong evidence and is not a continuum theorem or solver-error certificate.
falsifier: Source-hash drift, an unstable oversampling reference, nonconvergent collocation-to-Galerkin residual error, failure of the discrete energy-gradient identity, failure of the later finite-time or Hessian/Ritz convergence conditions, or an unexplained hardware/precision discrepancy invalidates the corresponding P3 stage.
no_overclaim: This T4 strong-evidence claim is not a theorem and does not supply a numerical enclosure of C(R,tau,T), a controlled continuum-error bar for arbitrary P2 or historical-solver trajectories, a completed dealiased finite-time Galerkin passage, full-spectrum Hessian convergence at a Sector-B candidate, validation on all GPU devices or grids, continuum validity of N32/N64/N128 Sector-B runs, minimizer or BCC selection, T5, T6, or T7.
next_action: Derive a computable enclosure of the positive-time solution-ball constants B6(R,tau,T) and C(R,tau,T) from the closed M2(R) input, propagate it through a dealiased finite-time evolution estimate, then obtain independent reproduction and tier review.
